entity.summary: Register your corporation, LLC, partnership or trade name with DCCA's Business Registration Division.
entity.quote: Responsible for processing and maintaining business registration filings for corporations, general and limited partnerships, limited liability partnerships, limited liability limited partnerships, limited liability companies, cooperatives, trade names

state_tax.summary: Hawaii has no sales tax; instead every business needs a General Excise Tax (GET) license, applied for online with the Basic Business Application (Form BB-1). Contractor license renewals also need a tax clearance in the same name as the license.
state_tax.quote: Hawaii does not have a sales tax; instead, we have the GET, which is assessed on all business activities.

unemployment.agency: Hawaii Department of Labor and Industrial Relations, Unemployment Insurance Division
unemployment.summary: If you have employees working in Hawaii you generally must register with DLIR and pay unemployment taxes, filing reports every quarter.
unemployment.quote: In most cases, if you have employees working in Hawaii, you must pay unemployment taxes on their wages in this state. Tax reports are due quarterly.

workers_comp.agency: Hawaii Department of Labor and Industrial Relations, Disability Compensation Division
workers_comp.summary: Private employers must secure workers' comp for their employees through an authorized insurer or approved self-insurance. Licensed contractors must also keep workers' comp in force (unless excluded) or their license is forfeited.
workers_comp.quote: Employers, except the State, any county or political subdivision of the State, or other public entity within the State, shall secure compensation to their employees in one of the following ways

residential_building.name: General Building Contractor (B) license, or the appropriate Specialty Contractor (C) license
residential_building.agency: Hawaii Contractors License Board (DCCA Professional and Vocational Licensing)
residential_building.covers: Anyone acting or advertising as a general engineering, general building or specialty contractor, except small jobs that need no building permit.
residential_building.threshold: Projects over $1,500 total (labor and materials), or any job that needs a building permit
prerequisites: Experience meeting the Board's rules (self-employed or unlicensed experience may count if verifiable)
History of honesty and financial integrity
Workers' compensation and liability insurance (and a bond if the Board requires)
residential_building.bond: Only when required by the Board
residential_building.insurance: Workers' compensation (unless excluded) and comprehensive personal injury and property damage liability insurance
residential_building.summary: Hawaii requires a state contractor license for most construction work, with a small-job exemption only when no building permit is needed. Applicants need Board-approved experience, a passing written exam, a clean financial history, and workers' comp and liability insurance.
residential_building.quote: No person within the purview of this chapter shall act, or assume to act, or advertise, as general engineering contractor, general building contractor, or specialty contractor without a license previously obtained
residential_building.note: Exact years of experience per classification are set in the Board's administrative rules (HAR 16-77), not confirmed here.

evidence.quote: Any project or operation for which the aggregate contract price for labor and materials is not more than $1,500. This exemption shall not apply in any case where a building permit is required regardless of the aggregate contract price

Any person unless the person meets the experience requirements as prescribed in the board's rules; provided that the board may accept experience acquired on a self-employed or unlicensed basis if the experience can be verified
Any person unless the person has successfully passed a written examination as prescribed by the board; (5) Any individual unless the individual is age eighteen years or more
A licensed contractor shall have and maintain in full force and effect the following: (1) Workers' compensation insurance
Liability insurance from an insurance company or agency for comprehensive personal injury and property damage liability; and (3) Bond when required by the board

commercial_building.name: General Building Contractor (B) / General Engineering Contractor (A)
commercial_building.agency: Hawaii Contractors License Board (DCCA Professional and Vocational Licensing)
commercial_building.covers: General building contractors (structures) and general engineering contractors (fixed works such as roads, utilities, excavation and grading).
commercial_building.threshold: Projects over $1,500 total, or any job that needs a building permit
commercial_building.bond: Only when required by the Board
commercial_building.insurance: Workers' compensation (unless excluded) and liability insurance
commercial_building.summary: Commercial builders use the same Contractors License Board system: a General Building (B) license for structures or a General Engineering (A) license for heavy and civil work, with the same experience, exam and insurance rules.
commercial_building.quote: For the purpose of classification, the contracting business includes any or all of the following branches: (1) General engineering contracting; (2) General building contracting; (3) Specialty contracting.

evidence.quote: Any project or operation for which the aggregate contract price for labor and materials is not more than $1,500.
Any person unless the person has successfully passed a written examination as prescribed by the board; (5) Any individual unless the individual is age eighteen years or more

electrical.name: Journey Worker Electrician / Supervising Electrician licenses (Board of Electricians and Plumbers); Electrical Contractor (C-13) license (Contractors License Board)
electrical.agency: Hawaii Board of Electricians and Plumbers; Hawaii Contractors License Board
electrical.covers: Individuals doing electrical work, plus the contracting business.
prerequisites: Journey worker: at least eighteen years old and five years full-time (at least ten thousand hours) of supervised wiring experience
Supervising electrician: registered as a journey worker for at least four years (or equivalent)
electrical.summary: Hawaii licenses individual electricians: a journey worker needs years of supervised wiring experience before the exam, and a supervising electrician needs further years as a journey worker. The business also needs an electrical specialty contractor license.
electrical.quote: No person shall act or assume to act as a journey worker electrician, journey worker specialty electrician, supervising electrician

evidence.quote: To be eligible for the journey worker electrician examination, an applicant shall be at least eighteen years of age and shall provide satisfactory evidence of experience in residential or commercial wiring of at least five years full-time or its equivalent, but not less than ten thousand hours

To be eligible for the supervising electrician examination, an applicant shall have been registered with the board as a journey worker electrician for at least a period of four years or shall have equivalent experience in the trade
A specialty contractor is a contractor whose operations as such are the performance of construction work requiring special skill such as, but not limited to, electrical

plumbing.name: Journey Worker Plumber / Master Plumber licenses (Board of Electricians and Plumbers); Plumbing Contractor (C-37) license
plumbing.agency: Hawaii Board of Electricians and Plumbers; Hawaii Contractors License Board
plumbing.covers: Individuals doing plumbing work, plus the contracting business.
prerequisites: Journey worker: five years full-time (at least ten thousand hours) as a plumber's helper
Master: registered as a journey worker plumber for at least two years (or equivalent)
plumbing.summary: Plumbers in Hawaii need an individual license: journey worker after years as a helper, master after further years as a journey worker. Plumbing businesses also need a plumbing specialty contractor license.
plumbing.quote: To be eligible for the journey worker plumber examination, an applicant shall provide satisfactory evidence of experience of at least five years' full-time or its equivalent, but not less than ten thousand hours, as a journey worker's or master plumber's helper

evidence.quote: To be eligible for the master plumber examination, an applicant shall have been registered with the board as a journey worker plumber for at least two years or shall have equivalent experience in the trade

mechanical.name: Specialty Contractor license (e.g., C-52 Ventilating and Air Conditioning)
mechanical.covers: HVAC and other specialized building trades are specialty contractor classifications.
mechanical.threshold: Projects over $1,500 total, or any job that needs a building permit
mechanical.insurance: Workers' compensation (unless excluded) and liability insurance
mechanical.summary: Hawaii has no separate HVAC board; HVAC contractors need the matching specialty contractor license from the Contractors License Board, with the usual experience, exam and insurance requirements.
mechanical.quote: others whose principal contracting business involves the use of specialized building trades or crafts.
mechanical.note: C-52 classification name taken from Board applicant lists; individual HVAC technicians are not separately licensed by the state.

evidence.quote: Any project or operation for which the aggregate contract price for labor and materials is not more than $1,500.

roofing.name: Roofing Specialty Contractor (C-42)
roofing.threshold: Projects over $1,500 total, or any job that needs a building permit
roofing.insurance: Workers' compensation (unless excluded) and liability insurance
roofing.summary: Roofing is a specialty contractor classification in Hawaii, so roofers need a specialty contractor license from the Contractors License Board.
roofing.quote: A specialty contractor is a contractor whose operations as such are the performance of construction work requiring special skill such as, but not limited to, electrical, drywall, painting and decorating, landscaping, flooring, carpet laying by any installation method, plumbing, or roofing work
roofing.note: Painting, drywall, flooring and landscaping are also specialty classifications.

evidence.quote: Any project or operation for which the aggregate contract price for labor and materials is not more than $1,500.

pesticide.name: Pest Control Operator license (structural pest control)
pesticide.agency: Hawaii Pest Control Board (DCCA Professional and Vocational Licensing)
pesticide.covers: Structural pest control operators (termite and household pest control).
prerequisites: Be at least eighteen years of age
Meet the Board's exam and experience requirements
pesticide.summary: Pest control businesses need an operator's license from the Pest Control Board, which requires passing the Board's exam and experience requirements and proof of workers' comp and liability insurance.
pesticide.quote: To obtain an operator's license, a person shall fulfill the following requirements: (1) File an application as prescribed by the board
pesticide.note: Lawn and agricultural restricted-use pesticide applicator certification is handled separately by the Hawaii Department of Agriculture (not researched here).

evidence.quote: Be at least eighteen years of age; (4) Satisfy the board's examination and experience requirements
Submit satisfactory proof to the board that the person has obtained liability insurance, pursuant to section 460J-25

asbestos.name: Asbestos worker / contractor-supervisor certification and abatement contractor registration
asbestos.agency: Hawaii Department of Health, Indoor and Radiological Health Branch, Asbestos Section
asbestos.covers: Asbestos abatement contractors and their workers.
prerequisites: State of Hawaii certification for every worker
Asbestos specialty contractor (C-19) license from DCCA
asbestos.summary: Asbestos abatement contractors register with the Department of Health, list their state-certified workers, and must hold a C-19 asbestos contractor license from DCCA.
asbestos.quote: For abatement contractors, a copy of the current C-19 license from the Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs (DCCA).
asbestos.note: Registration form dated 2016; confirm current process with the Asbestos Section.

evidence.quote: A list of employees including name, certification numbers and expiration dates.

lead_rrp.name: EPA Lead-Safe Certified Firm and Certified Renovator
lead_rrp.covers: Anyone paid to disturb paint in homes, child care facilities and preschools built before 1978.
lead_rrp.summary: Hawaii does not run its own RRP program, so renovation firms get lead-safe certification directly from EPA.
lead_rrp.quote: EPA administers the RRP Program in most Tribes, states and territories, but has authorized the following to operate their own programs: Alabama, Delaware, Georgia, Iowa, Kansas, Massachusetts, Mississippi, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Oregon, Rhode Island, Utah, Vermont, Washington, Wisconsin

evidence.quote: EPA's RRP Rule requires that anyone paid to perform work that disturbs painted surfaces in homes, childcare facilities and preschools built before 1978 be certified and their employees be trained
